tools.name: Kečínok v3.0
tools.source: local snapshot from ~/.local/bin/kecheenok1.py; no public source repository, license metadata, or package metadata found
optional_runtime: customtkinter (script has a built-in tkinter fallback)
tools.python_environment: The full installer owns the isolated environment at ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/dotfiles/python; launcher checks its interpreter and does not install packages at runtime.
portability_changes: Removed runtime pip install of yt-dlp.
Removed download/extraction of Windows-only ffmpeg.exe binaries.
Checks for ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH and shows an actionable Arch ffmpeg package message when missing.
safety_review: AST heuristic found no secret-like assigned literals or private IPv4 literals.
The script downloads URLs submitted by the user through yt-dlp; as with any downloader, the user controls those remote URLs.
No source app logs, user download directories, or credentials are included.
notes: No executable code was run during this review.
Kečínok launcher runs the app through the installer-managed isolated Python interpreter.

fetch_snapshot.provenance: Unknown upstream; preserved local x86_64 binary, NEEDED libc/libm, checksum recorded in python-and-git.json

final_export_decisions: Local /usr/local/bin/fetch was ultimately retained as a checksum-recorded binary snapshot.
Missing imported distributions make LG TV/MSS/PyInstaller launchers stale; only working Python commands are rebuilt.
Kecheenok startup dependencies are prepared in an isolated full-profile Python environment.
